title: AMD action: getupdatedvisits
description: List visits whose record changed at or after an ISO 8601 since timestamp (delta-sync feed, newest first). Returns since, limit, count, by_provider, by_provider_id, by_facility, by_facility_id, by_apptstatus, and a visits list. visits rows: visit_id, starttime, lastupdated, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, profile_id, reason, patient_id, patient_name, chart_number. lastupdated is the AMD modification timestamp.
